operating_notes.text: Authorised by SEBI to begin providing services as a Past Risk and Return Verification Agency (PaRRVA) from May 4, 2026, post pilot-phase completion.
Commercially launched PaRRVA platform (www.careparrva.com) with NSE acting as PaRRVA Data Centre (PDC).
Q4FY26 ratings and related services segment revenue ₹117.68 Cr, up from ₹97.61 Cr a year earlier; Others segment ₹13.25 Cr.
FY26 operating cash flow ₹147.68 Cr was 85% of net profit of ₹173.7 Cr; capex ₹8.3 Cr.
PaRRVA platform moved from pilot launch in December 2025 to commercial launch in April 2026.
Madras High Court vacated the asset alienation injunction on June 3, 2026, after prior compliance.

timeline.summary: SEBI authorised CARE Ratings to begin operational services as a Past Risk and Return Verification Agency (PaRRVA) from 4 May 2026.
Commercially launched the PaRRVA investment performance verification platform in collaboration with NSE.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹130.67 Cr (+19.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹52.83 Cr (+24.0% YoY).
CARE Ratings reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹473.07 Cr and PAT of ₹173.69 Cr, recommending a final dividend of ₹14 per share.
CARE Ratings Limited shared the YouTube link for its Q4 FY26 earnings call with analysts/investors held on May 14, 2026, at 1:30 PM (IST), discussing results for Q4 and FY26.
CARE Ratings made available the transcript of its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call held on May 14, 2026.
Madras High Court vacated the asset alienation injunction against CARE Ratings on June 3, 2026.

CARE Ratings executed Share Purchase Agreements and a Shareholders' Agreement on October 19, 2026, to sell a 9.90% equity stake each in CareEdge Global IFSC Limited to State Bank of India and NSE IFSC Limited, reducing its holding to 80.20%.
